title: NetworkMachinePairedPayload
description: network.machine.paired v1 (OpenVibe.Network, plan L34: the machines hub). A machine was paired with a person's account: it redeemed the one-time code and became theirs. It holds a credential from then on; the code is spent. The machine's device id in Bot is absent until the machine checks in for the first time. Envelope: subject { type: machine, id: <nod_…> }, visibility internal, actor service:network.

machine_id.description: The machine's device id in Bot's registry, when Bot already knows the device.

principal_id.description: The node principal the pairing created. Also the envelope subject id.

owner.description: The person the machine belongs to.
